model_system: ultrathin epitaxial (001) PbTiO3 ferroelectric film under out-of-plane electric field

key_params.representative_SkX_conditions: Ez = 1.2 MV/cm at room temperature for 48x48x6 nm film; or T = 500 K and Ez = 0.6 MV/cm for 160x160x6 nm film

headline_claim: A hexagonal close-packed polar skyrmion lattice is stabilized in a 6-nm PbTiO3 film, e.g. at Ez = 1.2 MV/cm (room temperature), before disappearing into a single-domain FE phase by Ez = 1.8 MV/cm.
replication_difficulty: medium — phase-field LGD setup is clear, but exact coefficients/boundary-condition details are deferred to the Supplemental Material.
